notices.text_zh: 十月银行假日：都柏林市和邓莱里-拉思当已通知，公立图书馆 10 月 24 日至 26 日闭馆，27 日重开。南都柏林、芬戈尔的时间表也是银行假日周末周六和周一闭馆，周日不开放。已登记的 My Open Library 自助时段除外（市里 Drumcondra、Pembroke、Raheny、Walkinstown；邓莱里 Dalkey、Deansgrange），没有儿童活动。图书馆万圣节场次在 10 月 31 日。
notices.text_en: October bank holiday: Dublin City and Dún Laoghaire–Rathdown have said public libraries are closed from 24 to 26 October and reopen on the 27th. South Dublin and Fingal timetables also close on the Saturday and Monday of the bank-holiday weekend, and Sunday is not an open day. Registered My Open Library self-service hours are the exception (city: Drumcondra, Pembroke, Raheny, Walkinstown; Dún Laoghaire: Dalkey, Deansgrange) and have no children’s events. Library Halloween sessions are on 31 October.

notices.text_zh: 10 月 25 日凤凰公园有马拉松，道路和大门大约到 13:45 前封闭。动物园照常开，但周日上午很难开车进去或停车，请多留时间。
notices.text_en: The marathon is in Phoenix Park on 25 October. Roads and gates are closed until about 13:45. The zoo stays open, but driving in and parking are difficult on Sunday morning. Leave extra time.

notices.text_zh: 国立博物馆因劳资行动取消了柯林斯军营 10 月 25 日的家庭面具工坊，以及死动物园实验室 10 月 31 日和 11 月 1 日的抽签导览。馆方还说展厅可能临时关闭，出发前再打开来源看一眼。
notices.text_en: Because of industrial action, the National Museum has cancelled the family mask workshop at Collins Barracks on 25 October, and the lottery tours at the Dead Zoo Lab on 31 October and 1 November. The museum also says galleries may close at short notice. Open the source page again before you go.

events.title_zh: 圣帕特里克公园：斯托克乐园
events.description_zh: 都柏林市议会布兰·斯托克艺术节的免费亲子乐园。教堂旁边有说故事、街头表演、游戏、脸部彩绘和维多利亚旋转木马。周六到周一都是 11:00–16:30，不用预约。周一 11:00–13:00 是声音更小的安静场。
events.venue: 圣帕特里克公园（St Patrick’s Park）
events.address: Bull Alley Street, Dublin 8

price.note_zh: 免费入场，无需预约
price.note_en: Free entry, no booking

events.description_en: A free family fairground from Dublin City Council’s Bram Stoker Festival. Beside the cathedral there is storytelling, street performance, games, face painting and a Victorian carousel. Saturday to Monday, 11:00–16:30, no booking. Monday 11:00–13:00 is a quieter session.
events.schedule_note_en: Saturday–Monday 11:00–16:30; Monday 11:00–13:00 is a quieter session

events.title_zh: 都柏林动物园：超自然寻宝小径
events.description_zh: 10 月 24 日到 11 月 1 日，园内有一条寻宝小径，做完交给出口处的收集箱，可抽小熊猫少年饲养员体验。周六和周日主要就是这条小径；吸血鬼角色和游戏在 10 月 26 日至 30 日 11:00–15:00。10 月开放到 17:30，最晚 16:30 入园；11 月 1 日改按 11 月时间，17:00 前闭园、最晚 15:00 入园。10 月 25 日马拉松期间，凤凰公园大约到 13:45 前不好开车和停车。
events.address: Phoenix Park, Dublin 8, D08 AC98

price.note_zh: 线上日票成人 €22.50、儿童（3–15 岁）€17，3 岁以下免费。门口成人 €26.50、儿童 €20。2 大 2 小线上日票 €62.50。10 月 31 日只在门口买普通日票时，一名着装儿童可免票，不能与家庭票或其他优惠同用。
price.note_en: Online day tickets: adult €22.50, child (3–15) €17, under 3 free. At the gate: adult €26.50, child €20. Online family day ticket, 2 adults and 2 children, €62.50. On 31 October only, one child in costume goes free with a regular gate day ticket. Not combinable with a family ticket or other offers.

events.description_en: From 24 October to 1 November there is a treasure trail in the zoo. Hand it in at the collection box by the exit for a chance to win a red panda junior keeper experience. Saturday and Sunday are mainly the trail. Vampire characters and games run 26–30 October, 11:00–15:00. In October the zoo is open until 17:30, last entry 16:30. On 1 November it switches to November hours: closed by 17:00, last entry 15:00. During the marathon on 25 October, driving and parking in Phoenix Park are difficult until about 13:45.
events.schedule_note_en: Trail runs in opening hours; October 9:30–17:30 (last entry 16:30), 1 November 9:30–16:00 (last entry 15:00)
events.booking_en: Buy tickets online ahead if you can

events.title_zh: 艾尔菲尔德庄园：农场半日
events.description_zh: 邓德拉姆市区里的农场庄园，有动物、花园和给孩子跑的草地。周二到周日以及银行假日 9:30–17:30，最后入场 16:30，所以 10 月 26 日周一也开。成人票最高约 €15，2 岁及以下免费，儿童票官网没有写成一个固定数字。
events.address: Overend Way, Dundrum, Dublin 14, D14 EE77

price.note_zh: 成人最高约 €15；2 岁及以下免费；儿童票以官网为准
price.note_en: Adults up to about €15; age 2 and under free; child prices are on the website

events.booking_zh: 可现场购票，假日建议先看开放时间
events.description_en: A working farm estate in Dundrum, with animals, gardens and grass for children to run on. Open Tuesday–Sunday and bank holidays, 9:30–17:30, last entry 16:30, so Monday 26 October is open too. Adult tickets are up to about €15. Age 2 and under is free. The site does not publish one fixed child price.
events.schedule_note_en: Saturday–Monday 9:30–17:30, last entry 16:30
events.booking_en: Tickets on the door; on a holiday, check opening hours first

events.title_zh: 国家植物园：免费秋游
events.description_zh: 格拉斯内文的国家植物园免费入园，周末和银行假日按夏季时间 10:00–18:00 开放，四个门提前 15 分钟关。10 月 26 日是银行假日，同一套时间。婴儿车可以进园区。
events.address: Botanic Road, Glasnevin, Dublin 9

price.note_zh: 园区免费
price.note_en: Gardens free

events.title_en: National Botanic Gardens: a free autumn visit
events.description_en: Free entry to the National Botanic Gardens in Glasnevin. Weekends and bank holidays use summer hours, 10:00–18:00, and the four gates close 15 minutes earlier. Monday 26 October is a bank holiday and uses the same hours. Buggies are allowed in the gardens.
events.schedule_note_en: Saturday–Monday 10:00–18:00, gates close at 17:45

events.title_zh: 柯林斯军营：博物馆惊魂自助小径
events.description_zh: 国立博物馆柯林斯军营的免费自助小径，10 月开放时间内可以解谜、找藏品。不用预约。周二至周六 10:00–17:00，周日和周一 13:00–17:00，建议 16:30 前入场。10 月 25 日的面具工坊已取消。馆方提醒劳资行动期间展厅可能临时关闭。
events.venue: 国立博物馆柯林斯军营（Collins Barracks）
events.address: Benburb Street, Dublin 7, D07 XKV4

price.note_zh: 博物馆和这条小径都免费
price.note_en: The museum and this trail are both free

events.title_en: Collins Barracks: self-guided museum spook trail
events.description_en: A free self-guided trail at the National Museum, Collins Barracks. During October opening hours you can solve clues and find objects. No booking. Tuesday–Saturday 10:00–17:00, Sunday and Monday 13:00–17:00. Aim to be in by 16:30. The mask workshop on 25 October is cancelled. The museum says galleries may close at short notice during industrial action.
events.venue_en: National Museum of Ireland, Collins Barracks
events.schedule_note_en: Tuesday–Saturday 10:00–17:00; Sunday and Monday 13:00–17:00

events.title_zh: 马拉海德城堡：幽灵小径
events.description_zh: 城堡园方 10 月 17 日至 31 日办的家庭万圣节小径，大约 1 公里，可以推婴儿车。日场适合容易被吓到的小孩；夜场 16:45 以后，有说故事和音乐。官网通知写明，活动期间植物园、蝴蝶屋和精灵小径不对普通门票开放。不是每天都有场，必须提前买票。
events.address: Malahide Demesne, Malahide, Co. Dublin, K36 YP65
events.schedule_note_zh: 10 月 17–31 日的指定日期；日场最晚 16:30 入场，夜场 16:45 起

price.note_zh: 日场成人 €17 或 €20，儿童（2–16 岁）€14 或 €17；夜场成人 €21 或 €24，儿童 €18 或 €21。两组价是平峰和高峰。2 岁以下免费，但仍要写入订单。每张票另加 €1.95 订票费。哪一天有场，以购票日历为准。
price.note_en: Day trail: adult €17 or €20, child (2–16) €14 or €17. Night trail: adult €21 or €24, child €18 or €21. The two prices are off-peak and peak. Under 2 is free but still has to be named on the order. Each ticket adds a €1.95 booking fee. Which days run is on the ticket calendar.

events.booking_zh: 必须提前在 thehauntedtrail.ie 买票
events.description_en: A family Halloween trail in the castle grounds, 17–31 October, about 1 km and buggy-friendly. The day trail suits children who scare easily. The night trail, from 16:45, adds storytelling and music. The website says the botanic gardens, butterfly house and fairy trail are not open on a normal ticket while the event is on. It does not run every day. Buy tickets ahead.
events.schedule_note_en: Selected dates 17–31 October; day trail last entry 16:30, night trail from 16:45
events.age_hint_en: Daytime slots suit younger children better

events.title_zh: 北岸图书馆：万圣节故事会
events.description_zh: Charleville Mall 图书馆的万圣节故事会，讲述人 Aisling Breen，10 月 31 日 10:30 开始。故事面向各年龄儿童，必须有大人陪同。一张票含一名儿童和一名大人。免费，名额有限。
events.venue: 查尔维尔摩尔图书馆（Charleville Mall Library）
events.address: North Strand, Dublin 1, D01 AX99

price.note_zh: 免费。一张票含一名儿童和一名大人
price.note_en: Free. One ticket covers one child and one adult

events.description_en: Halloween storytime at Charleville Mall Library with storyteller Aisling Breen, starting 10:30 on 31 October. Stories are for children of all ages and an adult must come. One ticket covers one child and one adult. Free, and places are limited.

events.title_zh: 豪斯图书馆：万圣节魔术
events.description_zh: 豪斯图书馆请 Reuben 做全家向的万圣节魔术，10 月 31 日 10:00 开始。免费。预约可邮件 howth.library@fingal.ie，或打电话 01 890 5026。看完若去码头，海风大，带外套。
events.address: 61-65 Main Street, Howth, D13 VY50

price.note_zh: 免费，须向图书馆预约
price.note_en: Free, book with the library

events.description_en: Howth Library has booked Reuben for a family Halloween magic show, starting 10:00 on 31 October. Free. Book by emailing howth.library@fingal.ie or calling 01 890 5026. If you walk down to the harbour afterwards, the sea wind is strong, so bring a coat.

events.title_zh: 拉什图书馆：面具手工
events.description_zh: 艺术家 Kim Jenkinson 带孩子做万圣节面具，可做搞怪的，也可做闪闪的。适合 6 岁以上，10 月 31 日 14:00 开始。芬戈尔图书馆总表在同一时间还列了另一场 4–7 岁的故事手工，预约时请跟馆员确认你要的是面具工坊。
events.address: Chapel Green, Rush, K56 ED95

price.note_zh: 免费，须向图书馆预约
price.note_en: Free, book with the library

events.description_en: Artist Kim Jenkinson helps children make Halloween masks, spooky or sparkly. Age 6 and up, starting 14:00 on 31 October. The Fingal libraries list also has another story-and-craft session for ages 4–7 at the same time. When you book, check with the library that you want the mask workshop.

events.title_zh: LexIcon：社区修理咖啡
events.description_zh: 邓莱里 LexIcon 与 Rediscovery Centre 合办。把开线的衣服或晃动的小木家具带去，和师傅一起修。上午场 11:00–13:30，下午场 13:30–16:00，每人限一件，每段大约 30–50 分钟。不是儿童专场，学龄孩子可以跟着学。
events.address: Haigh Terrace, Dún Laoghaire, A96 H283

price.note_zh: 免费，须预约上午场或下午场，每人一件
price.note_en: Free. Book the morning or the afternoon. One item per person

events.description_en: Run by dlr LexIcon with the Rediscovery Centre. Bring a split seam or a wobbly small wooden piece and mend it with a repairer. Morning session 11:00–13:30, afternoon 13:30–16:00, one item per person, about 30–50 minutes each. It is not a children’s-only session. School-age children can join in and learn.
events.schedule_note_en: Morning 11:00–13:30, afternoon 13:30–16:00

events.title_zh: 塔拉图书馆：儿童惊悚电影
events.description_zh: 南都柏林郡图书馆塔拉分馆的万圣节儿童电影，10 月 31 日 15:00 开场，适合 8 岁以上。小孩必须有大人陪同，一人一票。订票在 talib.eventbrite.ie，手册写 10 月 22 日 10:00 起放票。年纪更小就不必硬看。
events.venue: 塔拉郡图书馆（County Library, Tallaght）
events.address: Library Square, Tallaght, Dublin 24

price.note_zh: 图书馆场次。须在 talib.eventbrite.ie 订票，手册没有另写票价
price.note_en: A library screening. Book at talib.eventbrite.ie. The brochure does not list a separate price

events.description_en: A Halloween children’s film at South Dublin’s Tallaght library, starting 15:00 on 31 October, for age 8 and up. Children must come with an adult, and everyone needs a ticket. Booking is at talib.eventbrite.ie. The brochure says tickets go on sale at 10:00 on 22 October. Skip it if the children are younger.
events.booking_en: Booking required, one ticket per person

events.title_zh: 自由区万圣夜
events.description_zh: 都柏林 8 区的社区万圣夜，在 Digital Hub Depot。16:30–17:30 是专门的感官友好时段，17:30–20:30 是舞台和鬼屋，这段里仍有感官友好活动。鬼屋可能吓到幼儿，低龄可以只留在前一小时。免费。
events.venue: 数字中心仓库（The Digital Hub Depot）
events.address: Roe Lane, The Liberties, Dublin 8, D08 TCV4

price.note_zh: 社区活动，免费
price.note_en: Community event, free

events.age_hint: 低龄优先走感官友好时段
events.description_en: A community Halloween night in Dublin 8, at the Digital Hub Depot. 16:30–17:30 is a sensory-friendly hour. 17:30–20:30 is the stage and the haunted house, and sensory-friendly activities continue in that slot too. The haunted house may scare toddlers, so little ones can stay for the first hour only. Free.
events.schedule_note_en: Sensory-friendly 16:30–17:30, main event 17:30–20:30
events.age_hint_en: Younger children should use the sensory-friendly hour

events.title_zh: 斯沃兹城堡：亡灵节家庭日
events.description_zh: 斯沃兹城堡庭院里的亡灵节，11 月 1 日 12:00–18:00，免费。修复后的小教堂有追忆祭坛和讲解，室内有故事，室外有拉丁美洲食物、音乐，以及皮克斯电影《寻梦环游记》。有一段在户外，带外套。
events.address: Bridge Street, Swords, Co. Dublin

price.note_zh: 庭院活动免费
price.note_en: Courtyard events are free

events.title_en: Swords Castle: Day of the Dead family day
events.description_en: Day of the Dead in the courtyard of Swords Castle, 1 November, 12:00–18:00, free. The restored chapel has a remembrance altar and talks. There are stories indoors, and Latin American food, music and Pixar’s Coco outdoors. Part of it is outside, so bring a coat.

events.title_zh: 斯沃兹城镇公园：火焰节
events.description_zh: 芬戈尔火焰节的斯沃兹场在城堡后面的城镇公园，不是城堡室内。10 月 31 日 18:30 开始有现场万圣节音乐，19:30 放烟花。免费。声音大，结束时间页面没写，更适合能晚睡的大孩子。
events.venue: 斯沃兹城镇公园（Swords Town Park）
events.address: Swords Town Park, behind Swords Castle, Swords, Co. Dublin

price.note_zh: 社区夜场，免费
price.note_en: Community evening, free

events.description_en: The Swords stop of the Fingal Fire Festival is in the town park behind the castle, not inside the castle. On 31 October live Halloween music starts at 18:30 and fireworks are at 19:30. Free. It is loud, the page does not say when it ends, and it suits older children who can stay up.
events.schedule_note_en: Music at 18:30, fireworks at 19:30
events.age_hint_en: Better for children who can stay up late

events.title_zh: 布兰查德斯敦：火焰节
events.description_zh: 同一火焰节在千禧公园的场次。10 月 31 日 18:30 是吓人迪斯科，19:30 放烟花。住在 Dublin 15 不用进市中心。免费。幼儿如果怕鼓声、迪斯科和火焰，改选白天的活动。
events.address: Millennium Park, Blanchardstown, Dublin 15, D15 NH94

price.note_zh: 社区夜场，免费
price.note_en: Community evening, free

events.description_en: The same Fire Festival, this time in Millennium Park. On 31 October the scary disco is at 18:30 and fireworks at 19:30. If you live in Dublin 15 you do not need to go into the city centre. Free. If drums, a disco and flames are too much for a toddler, pick a daytime event instead.
events.schedule_note_en: Scary disco at 18:30, fireworks at 19:30
events.age_hint_en: Better for children who can stay up late

events.title_zh: LexIcon：希腊航海传统展
events.description_zh: 「希腊航海传统一万年」在 LexIcon 从 10 月 15 日展到 11 月 29 日。10 月 24 日至 26 日全馆闭馆，所以这几天去不了；27 日重新开放后可以看。周六 9:30–17:00 有工作人员，周日 12:00–16:00 只有自助。不是有主持的儿童场。
events.address: Haigh Terrace, Dún Laoghaire, A96 H283
events.schedule_note_zh: 10 月 27 日起可看，展至 11 月 29 日；周六有馆员，周日仅自助

price.note_zh: 图书馆展览，活动页没有另标票价
price.note_en: A library exhibition. The event page does not list a separate ticket price

events.description_en: “10,000 Years of Hellenic Maritime Tradition” is at LexIcon from 15 October to 29 November. The building is closed 24–26 October, so you cannot see it then. It is back from the 27th. Saturday 9:30–17:00 is staffed. Sunday 12:00–16:00 is self-service only. It is not a hosted children’s session.
events.schedule_note_en: On view from 27 October, until 29 November; staffed on Saturday, self-service only on Sunday
events.age_hint_en: School-age children will get more from it

events.title_zh: 考古馆：周日免费开放
events.description_zh: 基尔代尔街的国立考古馆，门票免费。周日和周一 13:00–17:00，周二到周六 10:00–17:00。11 月 1 日是周日。建议 16:30 前入场。金饰和沼泽古物适合跟小学孩子讲。展厅偶尔会临时关，要看某一件藏品可以先打电话 01 677 7444。
events.venue: 国立考古馆（National Museum of Ireland – Archaeology）
events.address: Kildare Street, Dublin 2, D02 FH48

price.note_zh: 门票免费
price.note_en: Free admission

events.description_en: The National Museum of Ireland – Archaeology on Kildare Street. Admission is free. Sunday and Monday 13:00–17:00, Tuesday–Saturday 10:00–17:00. 1 November is a Sunday. Aim to be in by 16:30. Gold and bog bodies are a good fit for primary-school children. Galleries sometimes close at short notice. If you want a particular object, call 01 677 7444 first.
events.schedule_note_en: Sunday 13:00–17:00; aim to be in by 16:30
events.age_hint_en: School-age children will get more from it

events.title_zh: 死动物园实验室：抽签导览（周六）
events.description_zh: 柯林斯军营死动物园实验室的家庭抽签导览，大约 30 分钟，观众抽动物名字决定路线。11 月 7 日三场：11:00、12:00、12:45，主题是「暗中的生命」。适合 7 岁以上，免费，不用预约，先到先得。10 月 31 日和 11 月 1 日的场已经取消，出发前再看馆方页面有没有新的取消。
events.venue: 柯林斯军营死动物园实验室（Dead Zoo Lab）
events.address: Benburb Street, Dublin 7, D07 XKV4

price.note_zh: 免费，不用预约，先到先得
price.note_en: Free, no booking, first come

events.description_en: A family lottery tour of the Dead Zoo Lab at Collins Barracks, about 30 minutes. The audience draws an animal name and that decides the route. Three tours on 7 November: 11:00, 12:00 and 12:45, on the theme “Life in the Dark”. Age 7 and up. Free, no booking, first come. The 31 October and 1 November tours are already cancelled. Check the museum page again before you go, in case more are called off.
events.schedule_note_en: Three tours: 11:00, 12:00 and 12:45, about 30 minutes each

events.title_zh: 死动物园实验室：抽签导览（周日）
events.description_zh: 同一抽签导览的 11 月 8 日场：13:15、14:15、15:00，主题是「暗中的生命」。博物馆周日 13:00 开门，时间对得上。免费，不用预约。10 月 31 日和 11 月 1 日的场已经取消。
events.venue: 柯林斯军营死动物园实验室（Dead Zoo Lab）
events.address: Benburb Street, Dublin 7, D07 XKV4

price.note_zh: 免费，不用预约，先到先得
price.note_en: Free, no booking, first come

events.description_en: The same lottery tour on 8 November: 13:15, 14:15 and 15:00, theme “Life in the Dark”. The museum opens at 13:00 on Sunday, so the times line up. Free, no booking. The 31 October and 1 November tours are already cancelled.
events.schedule_note_en: Three tours: 13:15, 14:15 and 15:00

events.title_zh: 都柏林动物园：恐龙发现体验
events.description_zh: 动物园秋冬日历写明 11 月 7 日有「恐龙发现」家庭体验，对象是 3–8 岁孩子和陪同大人。日历把它和限量工作坊放在一起，需要预约。没有写钟点，也没有写是否还要另买日票。
events.address: Phoenix Park, Dublin 8, D08 AC98

price.note_zh: 体验另售，钟点和是否包含日票以预订页为准
price.note_en: Sold separately. Times, and whether a day ticket is included, are on the booking page

events.description_en: The zoo’s autumn–winter calendar lists a “Dinosaur Discovery” family session on 7 November, for children aged 3–8 and the adult with them. It is grouped with the limited workshops and needs a booking. It does not give a time, and it does not say whether you also need a day ticket.
events.schedule_note_en: The calendar does not give a start time

events.title_zh: 都柏林动物园：小鸟亲子团
events.description_zh: 日历上的 Zoo Tots「羽毛朋友」，对象大约 1–4 岁和大人。11 月 4 日和 11 月 7 日都有，本条是周六这场。低龄专场，需要预约。日历没有写钟点，也没有写清是否包含入园门票。
events.address: Phoenix Park, Dublin 8, D08 AC98
events.schedule_note_zh: 11 月 4 日另有一场；周六这场没有写钟点

price.note_zh: 低龄专场，票价和钟点以动物园预订页为准
price.note_en: A session for little ones. Price and time are on the zoo booking page

events.description_en: Zoo Tots “Feathered Friends” on the calendar, for about ages 1–4 and an adult. It runs on 4 November and 7 November. This listing is the Saturday one. It is a young-children session and needs a booking. The calendar does not give a time, and it is not clear whether zoo entry is included.
events.schedule_note_en: Another session on 4 November; this Saturday one has no published time

events.title_zh: 爱尔兰现代艺术博物馆：周日免费
events.description_zh: 基尔迈纳姆的现代艺术博物馆，门票免费，建筑和院子本身可以带孩子走走。周日 12:00–17:30，展览最晚 17:15 入场。周一平常关闭，银行假日按周日时间。11 月 8 日只是周日开放，页面没有单列家庭工作坊。
events.venue: 爱尔兰现代艺术博物馆（IMMA）
events.address: Royal Hospital Kilmainham, Military Road, Dublin 8, D08 FW31

price.note_zh: 门票免费
price.note_en: Free admission

events.description_en: The Irish Museum of Modern Art at Kilmainham. Admission is free, and the building and courtyard are worth a walk with children. Sunday 12:00–17:30, last exhibition entry 17:15. Usually closed on Monday; bank holidays follow Sunday hours. 8 November is just a Sunday opening. The page does not list a separate family workshop.
events.schedule_note_en: Sunday 12:00–17:30, last exhibition entry 17:15

events.title_zh: 府邸圆厅：德古拉迪斯科
events.description_zh: 布兰·斯托克艺术节和 The Ark 合办的免费迪斯科，10 月 26 日银行假日在市长官邸圆厅，12:00 和 14:00 各一场，大约 45 分钟。DJ Donal Dineen 放万圣节歌。适合 4 岁以上，小孩必须有大人陪，大人也要票。有闪光灯和烟雾。免费但要领票。
events.venue: 市长官邸圆厅（The Round Room, Mansion House）
events.address: Dawson Street, Dublin 2, D02 AF30

price.note_zh: 免费，但必须领票。小孩和陪同的大人都要票
price.note_en: Free, but you must collect tickets. Children and the adult with them each need one

events.description_en: A free disco from the Bram Stoker Festival and The Ark, on the bank holiday Monday 26 October in the Round Room at the Mansion House. Shows at 12:00 and 14:00, about 45 minutes each. DJ Donal Dineen plays Halloween songs. Age 4 and up. Children must come with an adult, and the adult needs a ticket too. There are flashing lights and haze. Free, but you must collect tickets.
events.schedule_note_en: Two shows, 12:00 and 14:00, about 45 minutes each
events.booking_en: Free, but you need a ticket

events.title_zh: 都柏林尼亚：咒语瓶和魔杖工坊
events.description_zh: 中期假周二到周五的随到随做工坊，含在都柏林尼亚门票里。10 月 27 日和 28 日做咒语瓶，29 日和 30 日做魔杖，每天 11:00–15:00。适合 7 岁以上，必须有大人陪，材料馆方提供，名额有限。周六日没有这场手工。博物馆 10 月到 3 月每天 10:00–17:00，最晚 16:00 入场。
events.address: St Michael's Hill, Christchurch, Dublin 8

price.note_en: The workshop is included in admission. Online: adult €16, child €11.50, student or senior €14.50. At the door: adult €18, child €11.50. Family tickets: 2 adults and 2 children €50.50, 1 adult and 2 children €34.85

events.booking_zh: 工坊不用另约，门票建议网上买
events.description_en: A drop-in workshop on the mid-term Tuesday to Friday, included in a Dublinia ticket. Spell jars on 27 and 28 October, wands on 29 and 30 October, 11:00–15:00 each day. Age 7 and up, an adult must come, materials are provided, and places are limited. There is no workshop at the weekend. From October to March the museum is open daily 10:00–17:00, last entry 16:00.
events.schedule_note_en: Workshop 11:00–15:00; spell jars on the 27th–28th, wands on the 29th–30th
events.booking_en: The workshop needs no extra booking; buy the museum ticket online if you can

events.title_zh: EPIC：小心德古拉家庭导览
events.description_zh: 在 EPIC 移民博物馆里找「跑出书本的德古拉」，有线索、说故事和两个小活动。10 月 26 日到 11 月 1 日，每天 10:00、11:30、13:30、15:00、16:30。适合 6–12 岁。同一页后半还写了每天 13:00 的爱尔兰万圣节起源内容，买票时看清场次名字。红线 Luas 的 George's Dock 站可走过去。
events.venue: EPIC 爱尔兰移民博物馆
events.address: CHQ Building, Custom House Quay, Dublin 1, D01 R9Y0

price.note_zh: 成人 €24，12 岁及以下儿童 €16，含入馆。13 岁以上没有单列票价
price.note_en: Adult €24, child 12 and under €16, including museum entry. There is no separate price listed for age 13 and up

events.booking_zh: 建议提前买，去年很快满
events.title_en: EPIC: Beware of Dracula family tour
events.description_en: Hunt for “Dracula, escaped from the book” inside EPIC The Irish Emigration Museum, with clues, storytelling and two short activities. 26 October to 1 November, daily at 10:00, 11:30, 13:30, 15:00 and 16:30. Ages 6–12. The same page also describes a 13:00 session on the origins of Irish Halloween. Check the session name when you buy. You can walk from the George’s Dock stop on the red Luas line.
events.booking_en: Buy ahead; it sold out quickly last year

events.title_zh: 奥康奈尔街：不给糖就捣蛋市集
events.description_zh: 市议会在奥康奈尔街办的免费万圣节市集，10 月 30 日到 11 月 1 日每天 13:00–17:00。一直有脸部彩绘、市集、走动角色、南瓜地和黏液实验室，另有儿童故事、舞蹈工坊等。欢迎穿装扮。地图针标在尖塔，摊位沿这条街。
events.address: O'Connell Street, Dublin 1

price.note_zh: 免费入场，不用预约
price.note_en: Free entry, no booking

events.description_en: A free Halloween market from the city council on O’Connell Street, 30 October to 1 November, 13:00–17:00 each day. Face painting, stalls, roaming characters, a pumpkin patch and a slime lab run throughout, plus children’s stories, dance workshops and more. Costumes welcome. The pin is on the Spire. Stalls run along the street.
events.schedule_note_en: 30 October to 1 November, daily 13:00–17:00

events.title_zh: 梅园：怪物狂欢
events.description_zh: 都柏林 5 区梅园的万圣节下午场，10 月 31 日 13:00–16:00，有说故事、脸部彩绘、DJ 和魔术表演。小孩必须有大人陪。市议会公园页写它在 Malahide Road，有时叫 Donnycarney Park，名录地址是 209 Killester Avenue。活动页没有写门票，也没有预约入口。地图针标在 Malahide Road 名叫 Maypark 的公交站一带。
events.address: Maypark, Malahide Road, Dublin 5

price.note_zh: 活动页没有写门票，也没有预约链接
price.note_en: The event page lists neither a ticket price nor a booking link

events.description_en: A Halloween afternoon in Maypark, Dublin 5, on 31 October, 13:00–16:00, with storytelling, face painting, a DJ and a magic show. Children must come with an adult. The council’s parks page puts it on Malahide Road. It is sometimes called Donnycarney Park. The directory address is 209 Killester Avenue. The event page lists neither a ticket price nor a way to book. The pin is near the Maypark bus stop on Malahide Road.

events.title_zh: 巴利蒙：异世界节
events.description_zh: 巴利蒙社区在 Trinity Comprehensive School 操场办的万圣夜，10 月 31 日 18:00–21:00。有游乐设施、手工、马戏、本地舞台、拍照点和走动角色，夜里放烟花。声音和烟花更适合能晚睡的孩子。活动页没有写门票；旋转设施会不会另收费，页面没说。
events.venue: 三一综合学校（Trinity Comprehensive School）
events.address: Ballymun Road, Dublin 9, D09 TN22

price.note_zh: 活动页没有写门票。游乐设施会不会另收费，页面没说
price.note_en: The event page does not list a ticket price. It does not say whether the rides cost extra

events.description_en: A Halloween night on the grounds of Trinity Comprehensive School, run by the Ballymun community, 31 October, 18:00–21:00. Rides, crafts, circus, a local stage, photo spots and roaming characters, then fireworks. The noise and fireworks suit children who can stay up. The event page does not list a ticket price, and it does not say whether the spinning rides cost extra.
events.age_hint_en: Better for children who can stay up late

events.title_zh: 纽布里奇庄园：天黑后的南瓜
events.description_zh: 多纳贝特庄园夜里的南瓜灯小径，没有突然跳出来吓人的环节，婴儿车可以走，轮椅可能要人帮一下，路面有草地和碎石。活动排到 10 月 31 日。购票页写最晚 22:00 入场、23:00 结束；庄园页说开始时间随日期变，但都在 17:00 之后，以购票日历上的时段为准。停车不含在门票里。DART 到 Donabate 再走大约 15 分钟（1.4 公里），33B 路公交在门口停。
events.venue: 纽布里奇庄园农场（Newbridge House & Farm）
events.address: Hearse Road, Donabate, Co. Dublin, K36 VR90
events.schedule_note_zh: 夜场；购票页最晚 22:00 入场，23:00 结束

price.note_zh: 成人、青少年和家庭套票按场次浮动，以 Showpass 当天价为准。停车另买
price.note_en: Adult, teen and family tickets move with the session. Use the Showpass price that day. Parking is extra

events.booking_zh: 建议按入场时段提前买票
events.description_en: A pumpkin-lantern trail after dark on the Donabate estate. No jump scares. Buggies can do it. A wheelchair may need a push. The path is grass and gravel. It runs through 31 October. The ticket page says last entry 22:00 and close at 23:00. The estate page says the start time changes by date but is always after 17:00, so use the slot on the ticket calendar. Parking is not in the ticket. DART to Donabate, then about a 15-minute walk (1.4 km). The 33B bus stops at the gate.
events.schedule_note_en: An evening event; the ticket page says last entry 22:00 and close at 23:00
events.booking_en: Buy a timed entry slot ahead if you can

events.title_zh: 总统府：周六免费导览
events.description_zh: 公共工程办公室的总统府导览，大约 1 小时 15 分，免费。10 月 31 日场次是 10:00、11:15、12:30、13:45、15:00。票在凤凰公园游客中心当天先到先得，不能提前订，也不能订团体票。要带带照片的证件。6 月到 10 月另有花园导览，这一天花园是否一起走，以游客中心为准。游客中心本身有儿童游乐场和咖啡馆。国事忙时会取消，出发前再看总统府网站。
events.venue: 凤凰公园游客中心（领票）／总统府
events.address: Phoenix Park Visitor Centre, Phoenix Park, Dublin 8

price.note_zh: 导览免费。票在游客中心当天领，不能网上订
price.note_en: The tour is free. Collect tickets at the Visitor Centre on the day. You cannot book online

events.age_hint: 更适合能安静走一小时的孩子
events.booking_zh: 当天先到先得，须带照片证件
events.title_en: Áras an Uachtaráin: free Saturday tour
events.description_en: The Office of Public Works tour of the President’s house, about 1 hour 15 minutes, free. On 31 October the times are 10:00, 11:15, 12:30, 13:45 and 15:00. Tickets are same-day, first come, at the Phoenix Park Visitor Centre. You cannot book ahead, and you cannot book a group ticket. Bring photo ID. From June to October there is also a garden tour. Whether the garden is included that day is decided at the Visitor Centre. The centre itself has a playground and a café. Tours are cancelled when state business takes over. Check the Áras website before you go.
events.venue_en: Phoenix Park Visitor Centre (tickets) / Áras an Uachtaráin
events.schedule_note_en: Five tours: 10:00, 11:15, 12:30, 13:45 and 15:00, about 75 minutes each
events.age_hint_en: Better for children who can walk quietly for an hour
events.booking_en: Same-day, first come; bring photo ID

events.title_zh: 总统府：周六免费导览（11 月）
events.description_zh: 同一套免费室内导览的 11 月 7 日场：10:00、11:15、12:30、13:45、15:00，大约 75 分钟。票仍在凤凰公园游客中心当天领，不能提前订。花园导览页面只写到 10 月，这场按室内导览准备。要带带照片的证件。游客中心有游乐场和咖啡馆，导览太长的小孩可以留在那里。11 月 21 日没有导览，与这场无关。国事忙时会取消。
events.venue: 凤凰公园游客中心（领票）／总统府
events.address: Phoenix Park Visitor Centre, Phoenix Park, Dublin 8

price.note_zh: 导览免费。票在游客中心当天领
price.note_en: The tour is free. Collect tickets at the Visitor Centre on the day

events.age_hint: 更适合能安静走一小时的孩子
events.booking_zh: 当天先到先得，须带照片证件
events.title_en: Áras an Uachtaráin: free Saturday tour (November)
events.description_en: The same free indoor tour on 7 November: 10:00, 11:15, 12:30, 13:45 and 15:00, about 75 minutes. Tickets are still collected that day at the Phoenix Park Visitor Centre. You cannot book ahead. The garden-tour page only runs through October, so plan on the indoor tour. Bring photo ID. The Visitor Centre has a playground and a café if the tour is too long for a child. There is no tour on 21 November; that does not affect this one. Tours are cancelled when state business takes over.
events.venue_en: Phoenix Park Visitor Centre (tickets) / Áras an Uachtaráin
events.age_hint_en: Better for children who can walk quietly for an hour
events.booking_en: Same-day, first come; bring photo ID

events.title_zh: 法姆利庄园：园地免费开放
events.description_zh: 凤凰公园西北角的法姆利，园地、花园和画廊免费，每天 10:00–18:00，最晚 17:00 入场。房子为欧盟轮值主席国闭到 2026 年底，不要按室内导览去。户外免费导览 11:30 和 14:30，看天气，票在 Motorhouse 接待处的导游台领。园里有牛羊，狗必须牵绳。船屋咖啡馆每天开。这条先记到 11 月 8 日，之后是否照常以遗产局页面为准。
events.venue: 法姆利庄园（Farmleigh House and Estate）
events.address: Phoenix Park, Dublin 15, D15 TD50

price.note_zh: 园地、花园和画廊免费。房子今年不开放，室内导览票价用不上
price.note_en: Grounds, gardens and gallery are free. The house is closed this year, so indoor tour prices do not apply

events.booking_zh: 进园不用预约；户外导览在导游台领票
events.description_en: Farmleigh, in the north-west corner of Phoenix Park. Grounds, gardens and gallery are free, daily 10:00–18:00, last entry 17:00. The house is closed until the end of 2026 for the EU presidency, so do not come for an indoor tour. Free outdoor tours at 11:30 and 14:30, weather permitting. Collect tickets at the guide desk in the Motorhouse reception. There are cattle and sheep. Dogs must be on a lead. The Boathouse Café is open daily. This listing runs to 8 November. After that, check the Heritage Ireland page.
events.schedule_note_en: Daily 10:00–18:00, last entry 17:00; outdoor tours at 11:30 and 14:30
events.booking_en: No booking for the grounds; outdoor tours collect tickets at the guide desk

events.title_zh: 马什图书馆：周六自助参观
events.description_zh: 1707 年开放的旧图书馆，周六 10:00–17:00，周日和银行假日不开。馆方说特别欢迎小孩，有小人仔寻宝；楼梯不方便轮椅，工作人员可以帮忙把婴儿车抬上去。成人 €8，学生和老人 €6，18 岁以下个人免费；18 岁以下团体每人 €3。可以当天在门口买，也可以在网上订。
events.address: St Patrick's Close, Dublin, D08 FK79

price.note_zh: 成人 €8，学生或老人 €6，18 岁以下个人免费。18 岁以下团体每人 €3。领社会福利者免费
price.note_en: Adult €8, student or senior €6, under 18 free as an individual. Under-18 groups are €3 each. People receiving social welfare go free

events.age_hint: 学龄儿童更合适，请小声
events.booking_zh: 可当天买票，也可网上订
events.description_en: The old library, open since 1707. Saturday 10:00–17:00. Closed Sunday and bank holidays. The library says children are especially welcome, and there is a miniature treasure hunt. Stairs are not wheelchair friendly. Staff can help carry a buggy up. Adult €8, student and senior €6, under 18 free as an individual. Under-18 groups are €3 each. Buy at the door on the day, or book online.
events.schedule_note_en: Saturday 10:00–17:00; closed Sunday
events.age_hint_en: School-age children; please keep voices down
events.booking_en: Buy on the day, or book online

events.title_zh: 马什图书馆：周六自助参观（11 月）
events.description_zh: 同一座旧图书馆的 11 月 7 日周六场，10:00–17:00。小孩可以参加小人仔寻宝。展厅没有轮椅通道。票价和 10 月 31 日一样：成人 €8，学生和老人 €6，18 岁以下个人免费。
events.address: St Patrick's Close, Dublin, D08 FK79

price.note_zh: 成人 €8，学生或老人 €6，18 岁以下个人免费。18 岁以下团体每人 €3
price.note_en: Adult €8, student or senior €6, under 18 free as an individual. Under-18 groups are €3 each

events.age_hint: 学龄儿童更合适，请小声
events.booking_zh: 可当天买票，也可网上订
events.description_en: The same old library on Saturday 7 November, 10:00–17:00. Children can do the miniature treasure hunt. The galleries have no wheelchair access. Prices match 31 October: adult €8, student and senior €6, under 18 free as an individual.
events.schedule_note_en: Saturday 10:00–17:00
events.age_hint_en: School-age children; please keep voices down
events.booking_en: Buy on the day, or book online

events.title_zh: 国立美术馆：周日馆藏导览
events.description_zh: 11 月 1 日 11:30–12:30 的免费馆藏精华导览，在梅里恩广场入口附近的庭院集合，不用预约。常设展免费。周日开馆 11:00–17:30，展厅大约 16:50 开始从楼上往下关。开放时间页写过公共部门劳资行动可能临时闭馆，出发前看馆方社媒。
events.venue: 爱尔兰国立美术馆（National Gallery of Ireland）
events.address: Merrion Square West, Dublin 2

price.note_zh: 导览和常设展免费。部分临时展览另收费
price.note_en: The tour and the permanent collection are free. Some temporary exhibitions charge

events.description_en: A free highlights tour of the collection, 1 November, 11:30–12:30. Meet in the courtyard near the Merrion Square entrance. No booking. The permanent collection is free. Sunday opening is 11:00–17:30, and galleries start closing from the top floor at about 16:50. The opening-hours page has said public-sector industrial action may close the building at short notice. Check the gallery’s social channels before you go.
events.age_hint_en: School-age children will get more from it

events.title_zh: 国立美术馆：风笛与画
events.description_zh: 11 月 7 日 11:30–12:30，都柏林风笛手 Mick O'Brien 先讲爱尔兰风笛，再和导览一起看馆里和音乐有关的画。国际风笛日活动，免费，不用预约。在梅里恩广场入口附近的庭院集合。常设展免费。
events.venue: 爱尔兰国立美术馆（National Gallery of Ireland）
events.address: Merrion Square West, Dublin 2

price.note_zh: 导览免费。常设展免费，部分临时展览另收费
price.note_en: The tour is free. The permanent collection is free. Some temporary exhibitions charge

events.description_en: On 7 November, 11:30–12:30, Dublin uilleann piper Mick O’Brien talks about the Irish pipes, then joins a tour of paintings in the gallery that have to do with music. An International Uilleann Piping Day event. Free, no booking. Meet in the courtyard near the Merrion Square entrance. The permanent collection is free.
events.age_hint_en: Whole family, if they can stand and listen for a bit

events.title_zh: 国立美术馆：周末免费开放

events.title_zh: 马拉海德城堡：冬日灯海

events.booking_en: Buy from The Ark box office. 01 670 7788
